title: AssignedIdentifierMetaV1
description: The vocabulary a governance identifier must satisfy before it counts as assigned: non-empty, no leading or trailing whitespace, and not any spelling of a placeholder in any letter case. Read by the draft-governance gate, never restated in code.

assignedIdentifier.description: A string that has actually been assigned: non-empty, no leading or trailing whitespace, and not any spelling of a placeholder in any letter case.
